## F — Research and VERIFY index: Occupant protection, load and trip planning

Research index: Occupant protection, load and trip planning; mapped physical pages 26, 27, 28.
Part C contains 29 knowledge facts and part C2 contains 22 continuation facts. Individual source anchors and preaccept receipts preserve traceability.
VERIFY index: sec07-COUNT — exact official question count; sec07-PASS — exact official passing score; sec07-TIME — exact official duration; sec07-CADENCE — revision frequency.
Market and competitor debts: SEC-OCCUPANTS-MARKET and SEC-OCCUPANTS-COMPETITORS. Source-specific cautions are in part D.
Revision stability remains unknown, so the dossier carries a blocked-probe flag pending evidence; factual compilation is not independent QA or release acceptance.
VERIFY sec07-DATED-CHILD-SEAT-GUIDANCE: Physical pages26–27 contain historical carrier/seat guidance, including approximate age, weights, recline angle, forward-facing and shield arrangements. Verify against current issuer/manufacturer or regulator guidance before learner-facing safety release; preserve the snapshot only as publication evidence.
VERIFY sec07-CRASH-STATISTICS-AND-ANALOGY: Physical page28 crash-distance statistics and speed/height analogy have no dated primary study in the excerpt. Verify before presenting as current quantitative safety evidence.
